metadata.case_name: TAM SIU KEUNG V SUM CHEE HON TRSDING AS CHEE HON LUEN NGAI METAL MANUFACTORY

plaintiff.occupation_before: attending school in Form 4 and part-time worker (piece rates of $6.00 for 100 pieces)
plaintiff.occupation_after: maintenance technician for fire equipment (in training)
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: fully trained maintenance technician of fire equipment
plaintiff.education_level: Form 4 (attended evening school to complete Form 4)

injuries.description: A fracture of the distal phalanx of the right index finger
source:
A fracture of the distal phalanx of the right index finger and also the
right middle finger;

injuries.description: A fracture of the distal phalanx of the right middle finger
source:
A fracture of the distal phalanx of the right index finger and also the
right middle finger;

injuries.description: A partial amputation of the right ring finger
source: A partial amputation of the right ring finger.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation of other single finger

injuries.description: Ankylosis of the right middle finger (resulting in impairment)
source: the impairment of the right middle finger due to ankylosis was also assessed at 3%.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the wrist or hand

manifestations.description: distal phalanx of the Plaintiff's right index finger could only flex to 30° (normal flex 80°)
suffered considerable pain from the injuries and during treatment
only able to hold light objects with his right hand
able to write with his right hand but doing so causes pain after a short time
difficulty using chopsticks which cause pain to his right middle finger
cannot participate in playing basketball or doing gymnastics as well as other activities such as rowing boats

treatments_received: fractures treated with a wire through the fingers (pins)
out-patient treatment (3 times initially and later twice a week for about 5 months)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: could not participate in playing basketball or doing gymnastics as well as other activities such as rowing boats.

losses.category: Loss of ability to enjoy food and drink
losses.description: uses a knife and fork to eat food as he has difficulty using chopsticks which cause pain to his right middle finger.
now only able to hold light objects with his right hand.

losses.category: Loss of ability to pursue education
losses.description: intended to continue schooling to Form 5 but completed only Form 4; prospects reduced by only completing education to Form 4.
disadvantaged in the labour market throughout his working life and prospects of employment and advancement have been reduced.
